# Walter

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P12](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0012)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Di](../character/di.md) (sibling), [Jem](../character/jem.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Walter is considered very handsome and is noted as the handsomest of the [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) children. He possesses straight black hair and finely modelled features.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P13](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0013), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P23](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0023)_

## Personality

Walter is a highly imaginative and dramatic youth who possesses a vivid fancy and a passionate love of beauty. Known to be a frequent daydreamer, he tends to take the blame upon himself when issues arise and takes a fearful, exquisite pleasure in ghost stories and mystery. He possesses notable skill in both prayer and writing poetry, having previously won a prize for a poem he composed. Ambitious to one day become a poet himself, he also longs to see the Nile and the Sphinx, though he harbours a strong fear of physical pain and being hurt.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P13](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0013), [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 CHAPTER IV. ## History

Walter won a prize the previous year for writing a poem that his teacher had offered. He often spent time with his siblings and the Meredith children in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), where he read myths, shared stories, and described his poetic vision of heaven. Although he harbored worries about his own inability to confront bullies, he stepped up to defend [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md) and his mother when [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md) insulted them at school, challenging Dan to a fight. Despite feeling nervous and apprehensive before the match, Walter fiercely defeated Dan the following day, earning praise from Mr. Meredith and comfort from his mother. Inspired by a conversation with Mr. Douglas, he subsequently resolved to face his fears and get a tooth pulled. Later, while spending time in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) with the other children, Walter poetically described the Pied Piper calling to them as they gathered for Jem's final evening before departing for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P1](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P3](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P4](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P6](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER V. ## Quotes

> "The flower angel’s aren’t. They are a pale misty blue, just like the haze in the valley. Oh, how I wish I could fly. It must be glorious."
>
> — Walter — [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P22](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0022)

> “I never fought before—and I didn’t want to right up to the last—and then,” said Walter, determined to make a clean breast of it, “I liked it while I was at it.”
>
> — Walter — [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P68](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0068)

> "But I’m not going to be frightened any more, sir. Being frightened of things is worse than the things themselves. I’m going to ask father to take me over to Lowbridge to-morrow to get my tooth out."
>
> — Walter — [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P71](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0071)

> "It would be a big pain. I hate being hurt. Father said he wouldn’t insist on my going—he’d wait until I’d made up my own mind to go."
>
> — Walter — [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P14](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0014)

> "I didn’t say I would run. I said I wanted to run. That’s a different thing. I want to help people, too. But oh, I wish there weren’t any ugly, dreadful things in the world. I wish everything was glad and beautiful."
>
> — Walter — [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P18](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0018)

## Relationships

### [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dan-reese--walter.md)

[Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md) is a schoolyard antagonist who targets Walter and his friends with harsh insults, targeting both [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md) and Walter's mother, [Anne](../character/anne.md). Driven by a desire to defend them and overcome his own anxiety about standing up to bullies, Walter challenges Dan to a fight. After a intense struggle after school, Walter fiercely defeats Dan, earning praise from the local adults for putting an end to Dan's harassment.

- Enemy of — mutual hatred (since v5)  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P20](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0020), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P8](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P16](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0016), +3 more</sub>

### [Di](../character/di.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/di--walter.md)

[Di](../character/di.md) is Walter's sister and one of his closest companions. They frequently gather alongside their other siblings and the Meredith children in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) to cook trout, chat, and play. They share a close bond as confidants, opening up to one another about their secrets, poems, and creative visions.

### [Faith](../character/faith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/faith--walter.md)

[Faith](../character/faith.md) is a close friend and schoolmate of Walter, bonding with him during shared outings with their siblings in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley). Their relationship is full of spirited antics, including a moment where [Faith](../character/faith.md) dares Walter to ride pigs through the village streets. [Faith](../character/faith.md) offers her support to Walter during difficult moments, such as tying her ribbon to his arm before he faces a bully.

- Friend of — schoolmate and supporter who tied her ribbon on his arm (since v5)  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P41](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0041)</sub>

### [Jem](../character/jem.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jem--walter.md)

[Jem](../character/jem.md) is Walter's brother and a primary member of their playmate group. Together, they spend their days exploring [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), where [Jem](../character/jem.md) cooks freshly caught trout over campfires for Walter, their siblings, and the Meredith family. Their bond is built on shared childhood adventures and deep affection for their favorite neighborhood haunts.

- Sibling of — brother (since v5)  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P1](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P19](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0019), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P16](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0016), +2 more</sub>

### [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/john-meredith--walter.md)

[John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) is the local [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) minister and a trusted older friend to Walter. The two share an easy friendship where they can talk unreservedly with one another. Mr. Meredith offers warmth and encouragement to Walter, notably praising him after Walter overcomes his fears to defend the local girls at school.

- Friend of — chums who talk unreservedly (since v5)  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P2](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0002)</sub>
